description: Books a slot of someone's event type for an invitee, as their booking page would. start must be the exact start of a slot find_available_slots returned. Answer the event type's questions in responses, keyed by question id (required ones must be answered). Returns the booking and its manageToken: keep the token, it is shown only this once and is what reschedule_booking and cancel_booking need to act as the invitee. Fails with slot_unavailable if the time is not offered and slot_taken if someone else just booked it; then pick another slot. Fails with booking_changed if the round-robin host pool or activation changed while the call waited; call find_available_slots again before retrying. Choose locationOptionId from the event locations; askInvitee phone options require inviteePhone normalized to E.164 (common phone separators are removed). Use the same locationOptionId for slot lookup and booking. location_unavailable means the chosen option cannot be used by the assigned host. Pass the same durationMinutes used to find the slot; omission uses the event type’s default. Pass an idempotencyKey so that a retry after a lost response cannot book twice. For a one-time link, provide only oneTimeToken instead of handle/teamSlug/slug; it is consumed atomically with the booking. Unavailable links return the same one_time_link_not_found error; reschedule the resulting booking with its manageToken. For paid events, send the invitee to the public booking page to complete Stripe Checkout.

handle.description: The host's handle: the first path segment of their booking link https://<host>/<handle>/<slug>

teamSlug.description: Exact-case team organization slug from /team/{teamSlug}/{slug}; give exactly one of handle or teamSlug

slug.description: The event type: the second path segment of the booking link

oneTimeToken.description: Secret token from the path of /book/{token}. Give this instead of handle, teamSlug and slug to consume a one-time link; keep it private. Prefilled name/email are editable and do not prove identity.

start.description: The exact `start` of a slot from find_available_slots, unchanged

durationMinutes.description: Selected meeting length in whole minutes, from the event type's allowedDurationsMinutes. Omitted uses the default for a new booking, or preserves the original booking length when rescheduling.

locationOptionId.description: An id from the public event locations. Omission selects the default or first option.

smsConsent.description: Explicit invitee consent to SMS booking reminders. Requires inviteePhone.

inviteePhone.description: Required for an askInvitee phone option: + and 7–15 total digits including the country code, first digit nonzero. Spaces, parentheses, dots and hyphens are removed before E.164 validation.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag. Registered interface and notification languages: en, zh-CN, de, fr, es, pt-BR. Regional tags are matched to a registered language; unsupported languages and missing translations fall back to English. Locale does not change the meeting time zone.

guests.description: Up to ten additional email recipients, only when the event type has allowGuests enabled; otherwise guests_not_allowed

responses.description: Answers to the event type's questions, keyed by question id: text for short_text, long_text and phone; one option for select; a list of options for multi_select; true or false for checkbox

waitlistToken.description: Optional waitlist attribution capability; grants no booking priority or permission

idempotencyKey.description: Makes retries safe: a retry with the same key and the same arguments returns the original booking (replayed: true, manageToken null) instead of booking again; the same key with different arguments fails with idempotency_key_reused. Use a new random value (e.g. a UUIDv4) per booking; 1–255 printable ASCII characters. Keys are scoped to your API key.
